description: Call this first. Describes what the service holds: the reporters (JP, US, GB) with their currency, national code level, and for import and export the first month and the latest published month; per reporter also source (the agency to name when you cite the data) and latest_month (that reporter's own latest published month; data_through, also given as common_latest_month, is only the latest month published by every reporter for BOTH flows, so a reporter can be ahead); the HS levels, the datasets, how to choose between the tools (get_catalog, then search_items, then get_item_summary, then the specific tools), and the access limits that apply to you (history window, ranking size, whether an API key is in use). Takes no arguments. It also lists null_reasons, the fixed words used in *_unavailable_reason fields. Use it for "what period does the data cover?" and "what is the latest month?"; it has no product figures, so for a product use get_item_summary. Customs trade statistics of several reporting countries (Japan JP, United States US, United Kingdom GB) from their official customs data, monthly, by HS product code and partner country. value fields are in the reporter's currency (currency: JPY, USD, GBP or EUR) and *_usd fields in US dollars; ratios and shares are fractions precomputed from the full dataset; every answer carries reporter, currency, data_through (latest published month), the reporter's attribution, and notes. Maximum 200 rows per answer. Numbers in answers are rounded once, at the end: amounts (value, *_usd, v12 ...) to 2 decimals, quantity and kg to 3, unit prices (unit_price*) to 4 significant digits below 100 and 2 decimals from 100 up (never rounded to 0), and ratios, shares and growth rates (yoy*, mom*, share*, hhi*, chg3y) to 6; whole numbers and null are left as they are. A null quantity, kg or unit price comes with a *_unavailable_reason (mixed_units, weight_only, no_quantity_in_source, no_weight_in_source, source_gap, withheld; get_catalog lists them in null_reasons), and a missing seasonality with seasonality_unavailable_reason. The national level (JP 9-digit, US 10-digit, GB 8-digit codes) differs between reporters and between import and export; EU has no national level (HS6 only); HS6, HS4 and HS2 are shared. Import and export are separate datasets, so reporter and flow are always required for product figures. Rankings (limit) are limited to the top 20 without an API key (more is refused with out_of_scope) and to 100 with a free API key. Start with get_catalog (coverage, your access limits, which tool to use) or, when you already know the code, get_item_summary for a one-call overview of a product.
name: get_catalog
